name: Telling The Truth
overview: Scripture reveals that truthfulness is not merely a moral preference but a reflection of God's character, as those who speak truth are His delight while lying lips are an abomination (Proverbs 12:22). Jesus, the Word made flesh, embodies grace and truth, calling His followers to abide in His word to truly know the truth that sets them free (John 1:14; John 8:31-32). In contrast, the devil is identified as the originator of lies, living contrary to truth and leading others away from it (John 8:44). True worship and discipleship demand a commitment to truth grounded in the Spirit and the Word of God (John 4:24).
